title: Yu Irreducibility for Even Orthogonal Groups
body_html:
Yu Irreducibility for Even Orthogonal Groups

For \(G=O(V)\) with \(V\) even-dimensional, the representation \[ \pi_\Sigma=\operatorname{c-Ind}_K^G\eta_\Sigma \] constructed from a supercuspidal datum \(\Sigma\) is irreducible and supercuspidal.
proof_html: The proof checks Yu's conditions SC1, SC2, and SC3 for \(O(V)\). SC1 uses the same root-theoretic argument as Yu after replacing GE2 by the orthogonal-group variant following from the good-element condition. The needed Moy-Prasad integral models are obtained by viewing \(O(V)\) as a symmetric subgroup of a general linear group. SC2 is supplied by the Yu special isomorphism supercuspidal_theta.yu_special_isomorphism. SC3 follows from Yu's Sections 12-13 without change. Yu's irreducibility criterion then gives irreducibility and supercuspidality.
